jobs.title: Software Engineer, Sandboxing
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale

  • Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools

  • Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling

  • Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level

  • Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox

  • Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution

  • Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers

  • Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios

  • Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on

  • Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

Minimum qualifications

  • Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area

  • Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go

  • Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc

  • Unde

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.

  • Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

KDC (KRAFTON Developers Connect)는 KRAFTON Family가 하나로 모일 수 있는 장으로, 서로 다른 배경과 경험을 가진 사람들이 교류하며 창의성(Creativity)을 더욱 발전시킬 수 있다고 믿습니다.

2011년 전사 차원의 지식 공유와 기술 교류를 목적으로 시작된 KDC는 지난 15년간 유관 업계 종사자, 전 세계 스튜디오 및 파트너들과 지속적으로 교류하며 범 크래프톤 차원의 연결을 확장해 왔습니다. KDC 팀은 KRAFTON의 다양한 신작 개발 및 독립 스튜디오 간의 '연결'을 통해 상호 이해를 증진시키고, 개발자 간 지식과 경험이 활발하게 유통될 수 있도록 커뮤니티를 설계하고 운영하는 역할을 합니다.

이를 위해 KDC 팀은 세미나, 핸즈온 워크숍, 해커톤, 직군별 밋업 등 다양한 형식의 프로그램을 기획·운영합니다. 단순히 보고 듣는 것을 넘어 경험을 공유하고, 인사이트를 얻으며, 의미 있는 네트워크를 형성할 수 있도록 — '인정 → 자극 → 동기부여 → 성장 → 새로운 기회'로 이어지는 크래프톤만의 선순환 개발 문화를 만들어가는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
In Brief

We’re a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

You will build and maintain the infrastructure for the Bayesian platform and develop CI/CD to enable other team members such as software engineers, data scientists, etc. to accelerate their development will drive expansion of our clinical AI/ML module offerings, health system enterprise-wide implementations, and revenue growth.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health ’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.

What you’ll do

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and maintain the networking and infrastructure for the Bayesian platform and develop CI/CD pipelines to enable other team members such as software engineers, data scientists, etc. to accelerate their development. This role is crucial to drive expansion of our clinical AI/ML module offerings, health system enterprise-wide implementations, and revenue growth.

Responsibilities

Design cost-optimized, fault-tolerant infrastructure for scale:  Propose enhancement to our infrastructure design to enable us to expand our client base and deploy new products on our platform while managing cloud costs and ensuring reliability.

Streamline development and deployment:  Define a branching and promotion strategy that allow us to comply with the regulatory change control process. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub for automated testing and deployment.

Establish and evangelize infrastructure best practices:  Create infrastructure guidelines and templates such as Terraform modules, and educate team members in leveraging them.

Infrastructure support and maintenance:  Continuous monitoring of system performance and reliability, and apply software upgrades accordingly. Collaborate with other team members in troubleshooting infrastructure issues and optimize performance.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

  • Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.
  • Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.
  • Efficiency</

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Indiana and Kentucky to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly within Indiana and Kentucky, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with county commissioners and councils, Kentucky fiscal courts and judge-executives, mayors and city councils, plan commissions and zoning boards, state and regional economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the Indiana and Kentucky data center markets you cover

  • Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

  • Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

  • Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

  • Monitor community sentiment and local politica

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Your Role in Our Story:

ACT is strengthening its data, technology and AI capabilities as we build a more integrated digital platform alongside our core environmental commodities trading and market-making business. This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets.

As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops.

Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves:

Strategy & Governance

Client Platforms & Secure-by-Design

  • Embed security-by-design into new products and client platforms, partnering with Data, Architecture and Commercial teams to ensure emerging digital capabilities are secure from inception, while acting as a credible security voice to clients and counterparties.

Risk & Resilience

  • Lead enterprise security risk management, including risk assessments, vulnerability management and third-party/supply-chain risk, driving timely mitigation across core and digital environments.
  • Direct incident preparedness and response, coordinating detection, containment, eradication and recovery, while continuously strengthening incident and crisis-management plans.

Infrastructure & Emerging Technology

  • Secure ACT’s cloud and infrastructure through Zero-Trust-aligned controls, including identity and access management, segmentation and encryption, across a hybrid and multi-platform environment.

Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis) 
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location:  Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)

About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.  The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.  We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.  What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.  Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.

What you will do

Hands-on software development

•

You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data  •

You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams  •

You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform  •

You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow  •

You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure  •

You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software  •

You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•

You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

Managing product timelines and deliverables, making sure that the SoC Development follows the planned schedule and stays within budget.

Who are we?

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

At  Qualinx , we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things. At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology- you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

jobs.title: Designer Working Student - Employer Branding
jobs.description:
In a nutshell

We’re looking for a Designer Working Student to help bring Picnic’s people, culture and opportunities to life. You’ll join our Employer Branding team and help shape how candidates experience Picnic, with a particular focus on our LinkedIn page and campaigns.

You’ll create and edit visual content for our employer brand, combining design and video to tell stories that catch people’s attention. You’ll also take ownership of the processes behind our LinkedIn campaigns: helping plan content, coordinate assets, publish posts and keep campaigns running smoothly. From a first idea to the final edit and post, you’ll help make sure our content feels distinctive, engaging and true to Picnic.

You’ll work with colleagues across Employer Branding and our wider Creative team of 20+ specialists, including designers, videographers and copywriters. Together, you’ll make content that reaches candidates across the Netherlands, France and Germany.

Tricks of the trade

  • Create employer brand content: Design and edit visuals and videos for Picnic’s LinkedIn page, campaigns and other employer branding channels.
  • Own LinkedIn campaign processes: Help plan campaign content, coordinate the assets and timelines, publish posts and keep the process organised from start to finish.
  • Bring stories to life: Turn ideas, interviews and raw footage into clear, engaging content that shows what it’s like to work at Picnic.
  • Adapt content for different formats: Resize and refine designs and edits for different channels and placements, while keeping the look and message consistent.
  • Support the creative process: Work with Employer Branding and Creative colleagues to develop ideas, gather feedback and deliver content on time.
  • Learn and improve: Keep an eye on how content performs and use what you learn to help improve future posts and campaigns.

Your superpowers

  • You’re currently studying Visual Design, Graphic Design, Communication, Media, or a similar creative field.
  • You’re excited by both visual design and video editing, and keen to work across formats.
  • You have a portfolio or examples of your creative work that show a good eye for detail and a feel for visual storytelling.
  • You have experience with, or are keen to develop your skills in, tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and After Effects. Familiarity with Figma is a plus.
  • You’re organised and comfortable taking ownership of a process, managing details and following through on deadlines.
  • You’re proactive, open to feedback and happy to roll up your sleeves in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English (Dutch, French or German are a plus!)

Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get  an  answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Tabletop Exercise Lead, The Anthropic Institute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Anthropic Institute

The Anthropic Institute (TAI) is a function within Anthropic that works to advance the public conversation around AI.

The Institute is comprised of research teams tackling some of AI's most consequential societal challenges: the Frontier Red Team, which stress tests our systems against catastrophic risks; Societal Impacts, which studies how Claude is used by millions of people; Economic Research, which tracks AI's impact on people's jobs and the larger economy; the Rule of Law team, which studies AI's impacts to democracy; and more.

The Institute's mission is to reduce information asymmetries between Anthropic and the outside world, name and answer the hard questions implied by powerful AI systems, and publish these findings so that policymakers, researchers, technology leaders, and the public can reckon with what's here and what's to come.

About the role

The role. You will build and lead the Institute’s tabletop exercise program and the team that runs it. Based on trends visible in the exponential and in consultation with technical experts, you will set the research agenda: which questions the exercises should answer, which scenarios to run, with which audiences, and what each run is meant to test. You will own the methods that make results comparable across runs and turn them into findings people outside the room can use. You will hire and manage a team plus a bench of facilitators, and you will be the program’s public voice.

Why tabletop exercises? If RSI arrives, the hardest problems will be about making decisions under uncertainty. The people making them may not trust each other, and the authorities they work under may not be fit-for-purpose. A tabletop exercise (TTX) allows the people who would face that situation practice it before it is real. It also shows us what tools and information they reach for, including what they would need that does not exist yet.

Tabletop exercises are also a research method. You can run the same scenario many times, with different groups of people (and with many more AI agents playing in silico), and you start to see the distribution of decisions people make. This is one of the few ways to generate empirical evidence about the future, i.e., how people and institutions will respond to situations that have not happened yet.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the program’s research agenda: the questions exercises should answer, the scenarios to run, and the audience for each

jobs.title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

  • Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)
  • When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)
  • Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

  • Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

主要职责

  • 负责游戏中音效的设计、制作与实现。

  • 与 Game Design、Art、Narrative、Animation、Engineering 等团队合作，将抽象体验目标转化为可执行的音频方案。
  • 在保证艺术品质的同时，关注玩法信息传达、声音层级、可读性以及游戏性能。
  • 主动根据玩家反馈、测试结果和团队反馈持续迭代。
  • 与外部作曲家、录音师、音频供应商等合作，并能够提供明确、有效的创作反馈。

任职要求

  • 具备成熟的游戏音效设计与制作能力，能够独立完成从概念到游戏内落地的完整流程。
  • 熟练使用主流 DAW 及声音设计工具，如 Pro Tools、Reaper、Nuendo、Ableton、iZotope 等。
  • 熟悉 Wwise / FMOD 等音频中间件，并具备实际游戏项目实施经验。
  • 理解游戏引擎中的音频工作方式，具备 Unreal、Unity 或其他商业/自研引擎经验。
  • 对Gameplay Feedback、声音层级、空间音频和交互式音频系统有深入理解。
  • 能够理解产品和设计目标，而不是仅从单一声音资产的品质出发进行设计。
  • 具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能够清晰表达设计意图，并处理来自不同专业方向的反馈和分歧。

我们尤其看重

  • 能够从玩家体验而不是单纯从音频专业角度判断方案。
  • 能够解释自己的设计决策，而不仅仅依赖个人审美。
  • 面对设计、工程或制作限制时，能够找到体验、品质和成本之间的合理平衡。
  • 能够主动发现体验问题，并推动相关团队一起解决。

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • 모바일에 최적화된 인터페이스와 터치 기반 조작 시스템을 통해 손안에서 펼쳐지는 무한한 모험의 세계를 즐길 수 있도록 설계하려 합니다.
  • 원작의 방대한 오픈월드와 생존, 제작 시스템, 다양한 Pal과 함께하는 즐거움을 유지하면서도, 모바일 환경에 최적화된 플레이로 만들어 나갈 예정입니다.
  • Palworld Mobile에서만 경험할 수 있는 새로운 기능과 콘텐츠로 진일보된 게임 플레이 경험을 선사하고자 합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 커뮤니티 등의 아웃 게임 시스템 디자인
  • 이벤트 시스템
  • 로그인, CDN, 운영툴 연동 등의 서비스 및 운영에 필요한 기능 기획
  • 업적, 퀘스트, 성장 등 기본 시스템 구현 및 개선 작업

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 최소 3년의 관련 게임 기획 경력
  • 원작 팰월드 플레이 경험이 50 시간 이상인 분
  • 기획 의도를 컨셉화하고 능동적으로 제안하며, 이미지/툴/데이터테이블 등으로 시스템 구조를 구체화하는 능력
  • 다양한 구성원들과 피드백을 주고받으며, 성장을 추구하시는 분
  • 모바일 플랫폼을 고려하여 UI/UX 기획이 가능하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 팰월드 뿐만 아니라 러스트, 언던(모바일) 등의 생존 게임을 100 시간 이상 플레이한 경험
  • 이벤트 및 결제 시스템에 대한 업무 경험

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.

Scale is hiring a Staff Product Designer to lead product design for Scale's Public Sector business unit.

Public Sector brings AI-powered decision support directly to government and national security customers. You'll design sophisticated tools for critical operations including crisis planning, geo spatial- visualization, and human-agent collaborative canvases.

Much of this work has no established playbook. The conventions for how humans and agents plan, review, and decide together are still being written, and this role will help write them. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that scale it. The work spans four closely coupled areas:

  • Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

  • Velocity. The toolchains, development environments, and CI/CD that let inference engineers build, test, and ship across every accelerator platform.

  • Inference engine. The software between the accelerator kernels and the routing layer that serves every request.

  • Performance. Improving throughput, latency, cost, and reliability across the stack, with correctness treated as part of performance.

This is not a status-tracking role. You'll own outcomes end to end, often where no single team is accountable for the whole picture. Much of your value comes from crossing boundaries into Research, Safeguards, Security, Compute, Infrastructure, API, and our cloud and silicon partners, and bringing back the requirements and dependencies that no team sees from inside its own space. There is little process to inherit, and we want to keep it that way: you'll build the minimum machinery the work needs and remove it when it stops helping. And because this is Anthropic, you'll have Claude as a collaborator. We expect TPMs on this team to push hard on what AI-assisted program management and fleet operations can look like.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the programs that scale Claude’s serving fleet across accelerator and cloud platforms, from early direction through delivery.

  • Drive new capacity online end to end, working across compute, infrastructure, security, n

jobs.title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer

Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Build and improve automated test infrastructure for continuous kernel quality validation across multiple kernel versions and architectures

Maintain long-lived test suites that evolve alongside Ubuntu’s many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance

Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous kernel quality validation

Conduct performance benchmarking and regression detection across kernel releases

Measure and improve kernel code coverage, identifying gaps in test coverage and creating tests to address them

Execute and analyze stress tests covering CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O subsystems, networking, and filesystem workloads

Develop and maintain fuzzing harnesses to discover kernel vulnerabilities and reliability issues using tools such as syzkaller, Trinity, or custom fuzzers

Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team

Contribute to upstream test suites and testing frameworks

Document test methodologies, results, and coverage gaps

What we are looking for in you

Significant programming experience in Python

Experience designing and executing system-level tests: functional, stress, performance, or regression testing

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀은 우리 파운데이션 모델과 글로벌 프론티어 LLM을 다각도로 진단하여, 모델 개발의 방향성을 데이터에 기반해 제시하는 역할을 합니다. 벤치마크는 측정 축이 다양하고 점수만으로는 모델의 실질 역량을 판별하기 어렵기 때문에, 우리는 모델이 실제로 어디서 강하고 약한지를 깊이 있게 분석하고 그 결과를 모델 개선으로 연결하는 평가 체계를 구축합니다.

글로벌 프론티어가 주목하는 표준 벤치마크와 실제 사용 맥락을 반영한 자체 평가셋을 함께 운영하며 모델 동향을 추적합니다.

평가 결과를 모델·데이터팀과 공유하여 기술 로드맵과 데이터 전략 수립에 직접 기여합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 우리 모델이 집중해야 할 역량과 타겟을 정의하여 모델 개발 전체의 방향성을 제시합니다.
  • 데이터 contamination에 영향을 받지 않고 모델의 실질 역량을 측정할 수 있는 신규 벤치마크를 설계·구축합니다.
  • 프론티어 모델과 우리 모델을 진단하여, 새로운 모델이 등장할 때 적합성을 빠르게 판단하고 기술 의사결정을 지원합니다.
  • 데이터·모델팀과 긴밀히 협업하여 데이터의 약점과 모델 설계의 개선점을 도출·전달합니다.
  • 대규모 평가를 안정적으로 실행·관리하는 평가 파이프라인·플랫폼을 개발하고, 평가 결과와 인사이트를 중앙화합니다.
  • 연구 성과를 Tech Report 또는 NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등 탑티어 학회에 논문·워크숍 형태로 발표합니다.

  • LLM의 표현력·추론·일반화 메커니즘을 이론적·경험적으로 분석하며, 효율성·안정성·성능을 끌어올릴 수 있는 새로운 관점과 알고리즘을 모색합니다.
  • Language Model 기반 Agent 기술을 발전시켜 게임 환경을 스스로 이해하고 유저와 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 Gaming Agent를 구현합니다.

  • Scaling laws, reasoning, tool calling, agentic RL, efficient training, multi-modal grounding, omni-model, world models 등 LLM의 핵심 주제들을 폭넓게 다루고 있습니다.

다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 통·번역 등 언어적 장벽을 해소할 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.

[AI Research 본부 비전]

  • 크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 게임과 비게임 분야를 위한 자체 AI 핵심 기술을 연구 개발하여, 기존 사업의 경쟁력을 강화하는 동시에 AI 기술의 사업화를 지원하며 새로운 가치와 혁신을 창출합니다:
    • Multimodal Foundation Model, AI Agent 등 차세대 AI 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여 게임과 현실 세계에서 사람과 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 지능형 Agent를 구현합니다.
    • AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.

[Team 비전]

  • 저희 팀은 특화 모델(Specialized Model) 을 개발합니다. 많은 기업이 반복되는 고정 업무에 frontier 모델 API를 사용하지만, 실제로 필요한 것은 범용 능력의 일부임에도 매 호출마다 범용성 전체에 대한 비용을 지불하게 됩니다. 저희는 오픈소스 파운데이션 모델을 특정 업무에 맞게 빠르게 finetuning하여,
  • 특화 모델 개발 영역에서는 frontier 모델을 기준으로 타겟 업무의 품질·비용 기준을 수립하고, 다양한 규모의 오픈소스 모델을 평가하여 개발에 적합한 모델을 선정합니다. 이후 모델을 타겟 업무에 맞게 고도화하여 frontier 수준의 성능과 높은 비용 효율성을 동시에 달성합니다.
  • 평가 체계 영역에서는 특화 모델의 품질을 신뢰할 수 있게 측정하는 방법론을 설계합니다. Human gold label 기반 정량 지표, LLM-judge 기반 pairwise 비교, 결함 포착률 분석 등 업무 특성에 맞는 평가 프로토콜을 구축하고, 정량 평가와 정성 감사를 결합해 배포 판단의 근거를 만듭니다.
  • 또한 이러한 과정을 자동화된 파이프라인으로 발전시키는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.
  • 새로 합류하시는 분께서는 모델 증류와 finetuning, LLM 평가 등 특화 모델 개발의 전 과정을 함께 추진하며, AI 기술의 실질적인 비즈니스 가치를 만들어가게 됩니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

새로 합류하시는 분께서는 비게임 도메인 특화 모델(Specialized Model) 개발을 중심으로, 데이터 구축·모델 학습·평가·자동화까지 이어지는 End-to-End AI/ML 모델 개발 업무를 담당합니다.

  • 특화 모델 개발
    • 고객사 업무 데이터를 기반으로 frontier 모델과 대·소형 오픈소스 모델을 동일 기준으로 실측 평가
    • 모델별 품질·비용 Baseline 구축 및 Teacher/Student 모델 선정

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여 임직원들의 일하는 방식(Work & Workflow)을 혁신하는 핵심 조직입니다.

AXD FDE(Forward Deployed Engineer) 팀은 전통적인 개발 조직처럼 백오피스에 머물지 않습니다. 현업(게임 제작 스튜디오, 글로벌 퍼블리싱, 백오피스 등)의 한가운데로 직접 투입되어, 그들이 겪는 치명적인 비즈니스 Pain Point를 발굴하고 AI 기술을 통해 즉각적인 솔루션을 만들어냅니다. 전사 AI 해커톤을 이끌고, 최단 시간 내에 MVP(최소 기능 제품)를 런칭하여 '기술이 어떻게 재무적/시간적 성과로 이어지는지'를 현장에서 직접 증명해 낼 강인하고 속도감 있는 FDE 팀을 모십니다.

  • 비즈니스 요구사항 분석 및 아키텍처 설계: 비개발 직군(기획, 재무, HR 등)의 복잡한 요구사항을 정확히 분석·해석하고, 이를 AI 기반의 아키텍처로 설계 및 구현
  • AI 기술 도입 타당성 연구 및 ROI 분석: 도입된 AI 기술의 실제 비용 절감 및 업무 시간 단축 효과를 정량적으로 분석·연구하고, 성공 사례를 전사 스케일업(Scale-up) 전략으로 기획
  • 현업 밀착형 AI 프로토타이핑 및 해커톤 기획: 현업 부서와 직접 호흡하며 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고, 단기간(며칠~몇 주) 내에 AI 에이전트 및 자동화 앱을 설계·프로토타이핑하여 기술 검증 수행 (사내 AI 해커톤 등 전사 혁신 이니셔티브 기술 총괄 포함)

jobs.description:

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

"AI First 크래프톤을 완성하는 데이터의 심장,"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.
Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 이해하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 구조(Ontology)와 아키텍처를 설계·구축합니다.
크래프톤의 각 조직이 실제로 사용하는 데이터와 업무 맥락을 깊이 이해하고, 이를 AI가 이해할 수 있는 데이터 관리·활용 체계로 직접 기획하고 설계해 낼 분을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

담당 도메인의 데이터 관리·활용 체계를 직접 기획·설계하고, 설계 산출물(Ontology 설계서, 데이터 모델, 거버넌스 기준 문서 등)을 주도적으로 작성·관리합니다.

  • 도메인별 데이터 구조 분석 및 Ontology 설계: 도메인의 원천 데이터와 업무 프로세스를 분석하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent)가 활용할 수 있는 Ontology(개체·관계·속성 정의) 구조를 주도적으로 설계하며 Ontology 설계서를 작성·관리
  • 비즈니스 용어·지표 정의 및 데이터 거버넌스 기준 수립: 도메인별 핵심 용어(Glossary), 지표 정의, 데이터 오너십·접근 권한 기준을 현업과 협의해 수립하고 거버넌스 기준 문서로 정립
  • 데이터 품질·정합성 분석 및 개선: 원천 데이터의 정합성, 완결성, 중복 여부를 분석하고, 개선 방안을 직접 도출해 Ontology 설계 및 데이터 구축에 반영
  • 현업 부서와의 요구사항 분석 및 데이터 모델링: 담당 조직의 실무자를 인터뷰하고 업무 데이터를 분석하여, 실제 질의·분석 시나리오에 맞는 데이터 모델(테이블 구조, 관계, 계층)을 설계·구축하고 지속적으로 개선

  • SQL을 능숙하게 다루며, 원천 데이터를 스스로 탐색·분석해 구조를 파악할 수 있는 분
  • 특정 업무 도메인의 데이터와 프로세스를 깊이 이해하고, 현업과 커뮤니케이션하며 요구사항을 구조화해 데이터 모델·지표 체계로 설계해 온 경험이 있는 분
  • 데이터 모델링(테이블 설계, 정규화, 관계 정의 등)을 직접 기획·수행해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 새로운 개념(Ontology, Semantic Layer 등)을 빠르게 학습하고 실무에 적용하려는 의지가 강하신 분

Art Department 소개

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다. 그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

Visual R&D 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 예술적 창의성(Art)과 기술적 구현(Technology)의 시너지를 극대화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
우리는 게임 개발 과정에서 마주하는 다양한 난제를 해결하고, 크래프톤 산하 글로벌 스튜디오들이 최고의 퀄리티를 효율적으로 구현할 수 있도록 최적화된 솔루션과 제작 환경을 제공합니다.
현재 우리는 인게임 캐릭터 제작의 혁신을 목표로 하는 'VCC(Visual R&D Character Customization)' 프로젝트를 비롯하여, 차세대 그래픽 기술 연구와 개발 프로세스 고도화 업무를 주도하고 있습니다.
우리의 목표는 단순한 R&D를 넘어, 실제 프로젝트에 즉시 적용되어 성과를 낼 수 있는 실용적인 기준을 만드는 것입니다.
우리는 지금, 변화하는 개발 환경 속에서 유연한 사고와 협업을 통해 새로운 가치를 창출하고 프로젝트의 완성도를 높여갈 인재를 찾고 있습니다.
각 분야의 전문성을 바탕으로 크래프톤 전사 프로젝트의 성공을 함께 지원하고 성장하고 싶은 분들의 도전을 기다립니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 테크니컬 아트 문제 해결

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 담당 게임 및 IP의 시장 환경, 플레이어, 경쟁 구도와 사업 현황을 분석하고 중장기 퍼블리싱 전략과 성장 로드맵을 수립합니다.
  • 신규 게임, 신규 시장, 플랫폼 확장, 외부 개발 및 파트너십 등 새로운 사업 기회를 발굴하고 구체적인 이니셔티브로 발전시킵니다.
  • 신규 이니셔티브의 시장 규모, 전략적 적합성, 예상 수익과 비용, 투자 규모, 실행 가능성 및 주요 리스크를 분석하여 Business Case를 작성하고 우선순위를 제안합니다.
  • 잠재 개발사, 퍼블리셔 및 사업 파트너를 발굴하고, 제안서와 피치 평가, 역량 검증, Due Diligence, 파트너 선정 및 계약 협상을 지원하거나 주도합니다.
  • 파트너십의 역할과 책임, 권리 범위, 사업 구조, 의사결정 체계 및 주요 조건을 설계하고, 합의된 사업이 실제 성과로 이어지도록 실행을 관리합니다.
  • 담당 프로젝트의 개발, 출시 및 라이브 서비스 과정에서 주요 일정, 마일스톤, 의존성, 예산, 품질 기준과 리스크를 관리합니다.
  • 개발 스튜디오와 외부 파트너의 주요 PoC로서 업무 진행 상황과 쟁점을 관리하고, 필요한 의사결정과 후속 실행을 리드합니다.
  • 사업, 마케팅, 커뮤니티, 운영, 플랫폼, 데이터, 재무 및 법무 등 내부 유관 조직과 협업하여 프로젝트의 목표와 실행 방향을 조율합니다.
  • 주요 사업 현황과 의사결정 사항을 구조화하여 경영진 및 이해관계자 대상 보고 자료를 작성하고, 액션 아이템과 프로젝트 성과를 지속적으로 관리합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 게임 산업 내 게임 퍼블리싱, 사업개발(BD), 사업전략, 프로덕트 또는 프로젝트 관리 분야에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 다수의 이해관계자가 참여하는 프로젝트에서 일정, 리스크, 의사결정 및 액션 아이템을 체계적으로 관리한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 불확실하고 복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 우선순위를 설정하여 구체적인 전략과 실행 과제로 전환할 수 있으신 분
  • 글로벌 개발 스튜디오 및 해외 파트너와

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

Elasticsearch

Redis

Docker

Front-End

StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

Tailwind CSS

HTML

HTTP

AI Integration

Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

React for advanced front-end components

Graph databases for complex financial data

Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

jobs.title: Partner Manager, Global Health
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, governments, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences.

About the Role

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. The Enterprise AI business delivers performant, reliable, and production-grade AI applications to enterprises across all industries by providing Generative AI expertise and infrastructure.

The Role

Scale is looking for a seasoned world-class leader and operator to architect and expand our partnership ecosystem and transform how Scale goes to market globally. This leader will build high-impact relationships with world-class partners, focused on professional services firms, to accelerate the development of AI applications with Scale.

We are looking for a revenue-minded leader to own GSI-sourced and GSI-influenced pipeline. You should be able to set the strategy and also run the operating cadence it takes to turn alliance agreements into closed revenue: joint account plans, co-sell motions, practice building, and delivery enablement. You will source, evaluate, negotiate, and execute partnerships covering go-to-market, joint solutions, and delivery areas.

This is a highly cross-functional role, as you will collaborate across internal teams including product, engineering, finance, legal, marketing and operations.

You will

  • Define and deliver the strategy and roadmap for Scale's GSI partnership program, including partner selection, tiering, and investment priorities
  • Build trusted relationships with alliance leaders, AI practice leads, and C-level executives at top GSIs and consultancies
  • Structure and negotiate alliance agreements (e.g., resale, referral, co-sell, joint go-to-market, and delivery partnerships) and get cross-functional alignment on terms
  • Build joint account plans with GSI partners for Scale's priority Enterprise accounts and drive co-selling with Scale's sales teams
  • Help partners build Scale-certified practices: training, technical enablement, certification, reference architectures, and repeatable delivery playbooks
  • Co-develop industry-specific solutions and offerings with partners (e.g., financial services, healthcare, public sector, telecom) that solve high-value client problems
  • Design partner incentives, compensation alignment, and rules of engagement so Scale sales teams and GSI partners pull in the same direction
  • Generate significant top-of-funnel pipeline through the GSI channel, with clear accountability against Enterprise revenue targets
  • Bring partner and client feedback back to Product and Engineering so GSI delivery needs show up in the roadmap
  • Own post-signature execution: partner onboarding, delivery quality, joint marketing, and quarterly business reviews
  • Be measured on (1) GSI-sourced and influenced revenue, (2) number and quality of certified partner practitioners and joint wins, and (3) growth and health of the GSI ecos

jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics  is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Overview

As a Sr. Staff Engineer at Fanatics, you are a recognized technical leader. You operate both strategically and hands-on while leading ambitious projects, and your solutions set the standard for the team. Your bold decisions balance immediate business needs with long-term technical excellence. Through your leadership, you cultivate a culture of excellence and innovation that leaves a lasting impact.

We own the Fanatics App, the mobile app at Fanatics that encompasses elements from all of our different brands and businesses. The Fanatics App brings together Free to Play games, live events, ecommerce, and new product experiences to deliver a best-in-class Sports platform. Fundamentally, we are one team in everything we do, from the user experience to coding and architecture. We aim to deliver on our Customer Promise by delighting our millions of monthly active users.

Responsibilities

Develop a comprehensive understanding of the industry, product, and roadmap, leveraging this knowledge to shape team strategy and influence the direction of the organization

Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex features and systems, from ideation and architecture to deployment and refinement

Define and enforce engineering principles, guidelines, and best practices

Customer Focused, Android Platform expert driving decisions to best serve Android and the Mobile ecosystem for the Fanatics apps through Kotlin Multi-platform

Partner closely with product, design, and other stakeholders to make high-impact technical decisions that align with both business goals and long-term scalability

Work with iOS and Android leaders throughout the company to share best practices, code and entire features across multiple apps

Lead incident resolution as part of the on-call

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a member of the GTM team at Anthropic, you will be a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers and leads the technical direction of their AI adoption. Customers bring you in to lead, not only to implement: you decide what should be built, and then make sure it gets built well. You will work with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems, and guide the architecture and advisory work that surrounds those builds across an account.

Working closely with our Research, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and help shape our forward-deployed motion as it scales. We expect Staff FDEs to set direction under ambiguity and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. In this role, you guide architecture and build initiatives across workstreams, working directly with senior technical and business stakeholders and owning outcomes that span an account's roadmap.

You don't need to have shipped agents to production. You do need deep experience building and operating production systems, hands-on time with agents, and the judgment to lead architecture and advisory work with enterprise customers.

Responsibilities

  • Own technical strategy for a key account or vertical, in partnership with account and product teams.
  • Guide technical architecture and design decisions across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Lead discovery and advisory engagements independently, shaping scope and technical strategy before a build starts.
  • Lead engagements delivered with partners, setting the architecture and the quality bar for work you don't build yourself.
  • Review designs and unblock other FDEs on hard technical calls.
  • Represent Anthropic to senior technical and business stakeholders, including VPs and C-level, to align on strategy and de-risk delivery.
  • Own your engagements end to end: scope the work, sequence it, unblock it, anticipate security and procurement gates, and deliver production systems the customer can operate.
  • Work within customer systems to build production applications and agent compo

Scopely is looking for a Sr. Director Business Development to join our Global Publishing team!

The Business Development team is responsible for business negotiations, partner management, and new expansion opportunities with our largest IP partners, new distribution platforms (e.g. storefronts, hardware manufacturers, subscription services, etc.), and digital payment partners (e.g. Stripe, Visa, Checkout.com, etc.) around the world. Through these relationships, the team is responsible for creating and executing a strategy for each partner that drives audience and revenue growth for Scopely’s portfolio of games.

What You Will Do

Reporting to the SVP Publishing, the Senior Director, Business Development will be responsible for working closely with internal game development teams and key external partners to drive Scopely’s distribution and growth strategy globally.

  • Develop key relationships with top IP partners, new distribution platforms, and digital payment vendors in the gaming industry to support and grow the Scopely global business.
  • Articulate the Scopely vision and how we can most effectively partner together
  • Create and execute on a global business development strategy that connects to our overall distribution strategy and principles.
  • Source and negotiate large complex partnerships that grow Scopely’s overall consumer and commercial presence globally.
  • Partner closely with internal teams to ensure the needs of the business are being met in a timely manner
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally and an appreciation for the way business is conducted in different parts of the world
  • Keep tabs on industry trends by obsessively analyzing the market, playing all the new releases, and attending industry events and conferences

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of Business Development / Partnership experience within the digital entertainment industry
  • Experience creating and executing a global business development strategy
  • Ability to identify and negotiate large scale commercial agreements
  • Gaming experience preferred, and particularly free-to-play games
  • Passion & love for video games
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and all levels of management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changes
  • Ability to analyze data to make data-driven decisions - skills in Excel and Google Sheets necessary

Order Management sits at the center of how Figma turns contracts into revenue — every deal our Sales team closes passes through this team before it's invoiced. As Figma grows, we're building the order-to-cash process for what comes next, and this role is a builder's seat: you'll take on our most complex orders while helping shape how orders get processed, reviewed, and automated as we scale.

  • Own the order process end to end — from contract review and order entry through to invoicing — processing orders accurately and within SLA, including our most complex work with validation for completeness, accuracy and policy compliance
  • Serve as a go-to resource for Sales and Support on billing and invoicing questions, and partner with cross functional partners to investigate discrepancies and booking blockers across systems — following up to conclusion
  • Detail-review routine orders processed by other analysts and our BPO partners, identifying error patterns and driving them to resolution
  • Play a key role in UAT for new products, SKUs, pricing models, and billing system releases — writing and executing test scripts, running end-to-end tests from order through billing, documenting bugs clearly, and working with cross functional partners to resolve

  • Clear understanding of how order entry decisions flow downstream into billing and revenue
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills — pivots, XLOO

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. Our goal is for Claude to close the loop on scientific discovery, and a significant part of this is helping Claude to drive scientific hardware and software. You'll help deploy the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) to labs doing the world’s most important research. You’ll scale what you learn in the field by contributing back to the standard, building scalable assets, and driving associated internal product and research direction.

  • Work with labs to automate their experiments end-to-end with Claude - from advising, to prototyping, to writing production code.

  • Be an EMEA ambassador for Claude in the lab - you’ll both inspire and build trust with scientific audiences, from small settings to large conferences.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running. We make sure every employee can do their best work without friction. We're hiring an IT Operations Engineer to develop our global asset management and hardware lifecycle program across our offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, London, Dublin and Sydney. You will bring program expertise to how we track hardware as inventory through its whole life: procurement and receiving, the inventory of record, assignment, refresh, collection and recovery, e-waste and secure disposal, and reseller relationships, iterating and scaling practices as we mature. The same person runs day-to-day operations for our corporate mobile program in addition to expertise in management of laptop and workstation lifecycle operations.

You'll partner with several teams within the IT, Security and business operations organizations: IT Hardware Ops runs procurement, fleet logistics, onboarding and offboarding, the storage room, and physical intake. The Endpoint pod owns MDM, device policy and enrollment. Finance owns the budget and vendor contracts. Hardware requests that come through the IT Support queue land with the IT Support team, and you'll help define how they are handled.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Tooling

  • Develop the global asset management strategy: the lifecycle model, the data we keep on every device, and how each office executes against it
  • Select, implement and administer the asset management tool, define its data model and integrations, and partner with IT Engineering where the work needs platform-level access

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling gameplay experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, programming, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on gameplay systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System

Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team accelerates the work of organizations doing some of the world's most important under-resourced work: nonprofits, education institutions, scientific researchers, and organizations advancing economic mobility. jobs.title: Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Anti-Cheat is Riot’s first defense against cheaters that don’t want to play fair. As a cross-discipline team of former cheaters, kernel developers, machine learning engineers, data analysts, and software engineers, they make products like Vanguard to detect and ban the bad guys across all of Riot’s competitive titles and platforms, staying vigilant to whatever shape they’ll take in response. From beaming bots to scorching scripters, anti-cheat enables Riot’s game teams to take on competitive genres and design rewarding systems that would otherwise be too vulnerable to fraudsters and cheaters. Riot Machine Learning Engineers on Anti-Cheat are builders, trailblazers, and stewards of competitive integrity. We protect the legitimacy of Riot’s multiplayer games and player experience by building automated detection and decisioning systems to address a wide range of anticompetitive threats. As a Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist on Anti-Cheat, you will build machine learning driven detection systems to identify players engaging in cheating and other forms of abuse, and will develop agentic systems for reviewing and and actioning these players. You will partner with anti-cheat experts as well as game product, engineering, and insights teams to ensure that all Riot games afford safe, fair environments for players to compete and thrive. You will report to the Senior Manager of Anti-Cheat Data and Analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, train, and deploy real-time machine learning models to detect gameplay anomalies, automated bots, and memory-tampering exploits.
  • Build scalable inference pipelines capable of evaluating millions of high-throughput game actions per second with minimal latency impact.
  • Partner with anti-cheat software engineers to identify emerging cheat techniques and engineer high-signal features from raw game client telemetry.
  • Establish robust ML Ops practices, including automated model retrain loops and continuous monitoring for adversarial drift.
  • Analyze complex, high-dimensional player data to minimize false positives and maintain a fair, competitive environment for players globally.
  • Work directly with game design and gameplay engineering teams to balance strict anti-cheat enforcement with smooth, responsive, and uninterrupted player experiences.
  • Collaborate with the data engineering team to troubleshoot and optimize ETL pipelines, ensuring efficient data flow and processing.
  • Help set technical direction within Anti-Cheat ML in an ever-evolving anti-cheat landscape

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6+ years of experience delivering ML systems in production, including 3+ years in applied modeling or ML research roles.

The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

  • Partner closely with FDEs so the account runs as a coordinated team, not a set of parallel workstreams.
  • Identify and develop expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value
  • Represent customer reality to platform and leadership with enough credibility that it changes decisions.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Public Sector

jobs.description:
The goal of a Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to leverage techniques in the fields of generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and agentic AI to improve Scale's products and customer experience in production environments. Our machine learning engineers take advantage of robust internal infrastructure and unique access to massive datasets to deliver improvements to our customers.

Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Our work spans multiple modalities, with a strong focus on both large language models and computer vision. On the LLM side, we are developing agentic systems that help solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners. This includes building agent frameworks that integrate with custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, as well as evaluation tools to benchmark and refine agent behavior. We're also advancing research in areas like reinforcement learning for agentic LLMs, with successful deployment into real-world operational environments. On the computer vision front, we're training advanced models to increase labeling throughput and automate perception tasks. Our efforts include building large-scale fine-tuning pipelines, training models across multiple modalities, and developing generalizable vision foundation models to support a wide range of defense applications.

  • Improve and maintain production models through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics
  • Collaborate with product and research teams to identify and prototype ML-driven product enhancements, including for upcoming product lines

  • Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services

jobs.title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
